escalation.ask: Contact the national payment network operator to restore service. Clearing will drain its pending backlog of 111 items once the network answers. Do not quarantine item 94: it is not malformed, it waits only because the network times out.

sbar.situation: Recovery is not confirmed. The national payment network, run by an outside organisation, is down and every clearing send to it times out.
sbar.background: The network stopped answering, and clearing requests now fail 100% of the time (baseline 0%) with p95 latency of 2027 ms. The clearing backlog has grown to 111 pending items behind it.
sbar.assessment: The root cause is an outage on the national payment network itself (confidence 0.93). No allowed action could fix it, so the incident commander escalated to the network operator; item 94 is not poison and waits only because of the timeout, and the screening-standby restarts were routine and caused no symptom.
sbar.recommendation: Follow up with the national payment network operator, who has been asked to restore service, and confirm clearing drains its 111 pending items once the network answers. Do not quarantine item 94; operations should review the delayed payments in the backlog for settlement and customer impact.
